run_main_success_rate: run the CLI to compute success rate for robot task trajectories across all tasks in a dataset
compute_object_tracking_error: compute object position and quaternion tracking error between a trajectory and its kinematic reference
quat_to_vel: convert a quaternion array in wxyz format to angular velocity
mul_quat: multiply two quaternion arrays element-wise using Hamilton product in wxyz format
quat_sub: compute the angular difference between two quaternions by subtracting one from the other
